criteria.reasoning: The memo states "This later-entered $250.00 manual posting duplicates G-41817, which carries PayBridge transaction pbt_7Q6M77. PayBridge reports one $250.00 transaction". It directs "Delete G-41822 and retain G-41817", with an effect of −$250.00.
The memo states "CRM records $15,000.00, but bank deposit RDC-0710-1, item 2, check #4410, records $1,500.00" and directs "Edit the gift amount to $1,500.00", a −$13,500.00 effect.
For Etxeberria the memo directs "Void the July 13 acknowledgment and send a corrected acknowledgment." This comes immediately after the amount is corrected to $1,500.

The memo says "Keep the original gift. Post a new −$500.00 gift adjustment dated July 16, 2026" for Hollis Grant's NSF check #2231. The $15 fee is coded separately to bank fees rather than reversed as a gift.
The memo states "Change the gift date to June 30, 2026 and move the gift to B-2606-YE" because "the recorded postmark is June 30, 2026. It belongs to FY2026."

The memo makes no adjustment to the Doyle or Ochieng gifts. It states "No other gift-date correction is indicated by the recorded postmarks and receipt dates. A June date written on a check does not, by itself, move a gift to FY2026."
The memo states "The gross-to-net difference is expected, not a gift error" and "Retain gross gift amounts in CRM". The fees are a general-ledger entry by Finance, not a CRM adjustment.
The memo states "July card transactions total $3,335.00 gross, $77.87 in fees, and $3,257.13 net payouts."

For the $86.40 Valley Office Supply refund the memo says "It is bank activity, not a gift", "No CRM entry. Finance should code the refund in the general ledger". It is not counted in the corrected batch total.
The memo states "The corrected July gift-batch total is $17,130.00" and shows $32,380.00 less $15,250.00.

The tie-out adds the $1,000.00 Lindgren gift and the $86.40 Valley Office Supply refund and deducts $77.87 PayBridge fees and the $15.00 fee. It reaches "$18,123.53", which matches the reported bank net, with "Unexplained difference $0.00".
